_about: SHIELD v1 (ShieldMount.cs): where the offHand shield sits on Joan's left hand. Same maths as weapon_grip.json: socketOffset = metres in the HAND-bone frame, socketEuler = degrees on the socket (origin = the grip bar, +Z = the shield face, +Y = up). Rows are matched by character (Roster name / id / *) and item; a row with states applies in those Animator states (blended over blendSeconds), the row without states is the default. visible 0 = stow: the shield shrinks into the fist and the fingers open (used where the left hand is needed on the sword or the clip drives the arm through the shield: dodge_corkscrew, dodge_diveroll, get_up, atk_riposte, atk_thrust, hit_heavy, every finisher). hideDuringFinishers also hides it while a finisher scene runs (their clips are not Animator states). hideWithTwoHanded: a two-handed mainHand weapon (TwoHandIK) hides it. scale = world scale of the glb (authored in metres, 0.60 m round). curl closes the left fingers on the grip bar (GripPose axes, absolute) while it shows. Rows fitted and swept in Blender on Joan_combat.glb + her clip glbs with the game's socket maths (_agents/laneSHIELD/work/shield_fit.py).
